project.name: ai-marketing-skills
project.description: AI Marketing Skills suite orchestrated as a Ruflo meta-harness. Marketing and sales workflows run as coordinated agent swarms with persistent shared memory.

hierarchical.description: Queen-led campaign orchestration. A strategist decomposes a goal and delegates to specialist workers. Use for end-to-end campaign launches spanning multiple channels.

mesh.description: Peer-to-peer revenue intelligence. Agents share findings laterally to converge on pricing, attribution, and forecast decisions. Use for cross-functional revenue analysis where no single owner exists.

pipeline.description: Sequential content assembly line. Each stage consumes the previous stage's output. Use for producing and repurposing content at scale.

namespaces.marketing/playbook: Proven, promoted best practices from won experiments (growth-experimenter writes, all read).
namespaces.marketing/icp: Ideal customer profile, continuously refined from win/loss data (pipeline-router owns).
namespaces.marketing/experiments: Live experiment state, hypotheses, and data points (growth-experimenter owns).
namespaces.marketing/content: Editorial brain: voice, scored drafts, quote bank, repurposing assets (content-producer owns).
namespaces.marketing/revenue: Attribution, pricing patterns, forecast, and call insights (revenue-mesh shared).
namespaces.marketing/keywords: SEO opportunity map and trend signals (seo-strategist owns).

modelRouting.description: Tiered routing keeps ~75% of turns on cheaper models; escalate only for strategy and scoring.
